revocation_source: root-owned release policy; an issuer is admitted here only after the owner records the exact issuer identity for the semantic retirement-approval role
issuer_state_reason: No production release-retirement approval issuer exists on current main. Issue #2968 authorizes the narrow issuer seam and this explicit fail-closed state; it does not authorize inventing a semantic retirement authority. Until the root owner admits exactly one issuer identity here, no detached Governor retirement approval can be actionable and every release of a candidate that still contains the legacy facade stays Retained.
authenticode_code_signing_policy: Authenticode Code Signing signers are NOT admitted for the semantic retirement-approval role. The existing Authenticode/RFC3161 finalizer may reuse the existing certificate machinery only as a cryptographic primitive; Code Signing EKU alone never confers semantic retirement authority.
